name: mild_day_planned_window_no_pause
description: Mild day with windows_recommended=True and planned window 10:00–17:00. Outdoor is cooler than indoor but no fan is configured. Sensor opens at 12:00 (inside the window). Issue #1211 (A3): the planned window is no longer an exemption in the handler — the nat-vent entry gate runs and, with no working fan, refuses, so the handler pauses right there (the HVAC was already off; the pause is recorded and the occupant notified).
notes: _handle_sensor_open() checks: paused? → grace? → nat-vent entry gate → pause. Issue #1211 (A3, owner decision O8b): the planned-window early return that used to sit before the gate is gone.
Before #1211 production returned silently inside the planned window and the pause (or the nat-vent start) happened only a refresh later, through the comfort-band guard. Now the handler decides.

outdoor=65F < indoor=73F, indoor=73F > comfort_heat=70F, outdoor < threshold — the temperature gate passes, but no fan is configured (fan_mode defaults to disabled), so there is no working fan and nat-vent is refused; the handler pauses.
Nat-vent starting from the handler inside the period is covered by the pending scenario mild_day_planned_window_natvent_start_1211 (fan configured).
Name kept for the manifest; 'no_pause' describes the pre-#1211 behaviour (rename is an owner call).
Covers Priority 6 mild_day_planned_window from plan abundant-mapping-clarke.md (C5×E1 cell).

events.note: Late morning: indoor 73F, outdoor 65F — nat-vent conditions would be favorable
Window opens at 12:00 inside the 10:00–17:00 planned window — Issue #1211: the handler runs the nat-vent gate (refused: no fan) and pauses

assertions.reason: Mild-day classification applied: hvac_mode=off, windows_recommended=True, 10:00–17:00 window

sensor_open during the planned window period with no working fan: the nat-vent entry gate refuses and handle_door_window_open() pauses right there (Issue #1211 A3 / O8b). Before #1211 it returned silently and the pause waited for the next refresh.

verdict.summary: Window opened inside the planned period with no fan: the handler pauses itself (no refresh dependency)
verdict.observed_behavior: classification_applied (off, windows recommended) → sensor_open at 12:00 → paused
verdict.expected_behavior: A window left open past the debounce pauses the HVAC even inside the planned window when nat-vent cannot run (household rule 3)
